You ask for peer-reviewed speculation, cite non-existent journals ('Per Journal of Interstellar Consumerism, Vol. 7'), and reject real-world specs as 'too 2024'. You abandon checkout saying 'I need to meditate on quantum compatibility'—then return with a new sci-fi premise.
